messages:
marta: Hey team — spotted an unexpected invoice line for AcmeHealth (INV-20260315). There's a line called `Ancillary Support Surcharge` for $12,500. We don't have any signed addendum that authorizes this. Did sales/ops push this through as a pilot? cc @olivia

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260315 created for AcmeHealth. Lines:
- Platform Fee (annual): $120,000
- Support (enterprise): $30,000
- Ancillary Support Surcharge: $12,500
Tax: $0
Total: $162,500

olivia: We did an internal pricing experiment, but my notes show no customer-signed SOW for a surcharge. We only agreed to a support tier bump (enterprise -> enterprise-plus) during negotiation, not an extra surcharge.

raj: Pulling the SFDC record now — there's an entry: `Commit Annex Annex-934` created 2026-03-10, owner: raj.salesops, status: Approved - Billing Pilot. It has a custom field `ancillary_support=true`. I didn't realize it auto-ticked billing. Oops.

mike: FYI that annex was created as part of a private-deploy pricing pilot. The intent was to test an optional onboarding surcharge but legal hadn't signed the customer-facing addendum. Looks like billing pipeline picked up the annex flag and generated the line. We should not invoice until legal signs.

marta: Ok. From a finance perspective we need to reverse the $12,500 and avoid recognizing revenue. Please confirm next steps so we can issue a credit memo this week.

sarah: Agreed. Proposed steps:
1) Issue credit memo for $12,500 (CM-20260320) pending approvals.
2) Patch billing rule to ignore `ancillary_support` until `sow_signed=true`.
3) Sales to follow up with Acme and confirm whether they accept the annex (if they do, we'll re-bill with retro approval).
4) Post a reconciliation entry to the March month close with memo "Pilot surcharge reversed - pending SOW".

olivia: I'll escalate to Legal and attach Annex-934. I'll also open a customer-facing thread so Acme knows we won't bill the surcharge until it's signed.

raj: I created a support ticket: #SUP-8942 "Customer notification: surcharge not yet approved" and linked it to Annex-934. Also unlinked the Annex from the automatic billing pipeline for now.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-20260320 for $12,500 created and routed to finance approval queue.

mike: Approving CM-20260320 from my side. Also filing an internal postmortem to stop auto-billing experimental flags. I'll add a checklist to prevent future surprises.

sarah: Thanks. Please include GL code: 4105 (rebates/credits) on the CM. I'll process the reversal in our AR system today and include the memo for audit.

marta: Perfect. For the record: this is a billing rules hygiene issue + sales experiment. We'll coordinate with Product to ensure experiments have a billing-safe flag.

olivia: Posting update to the customer now. Will loop Legal and close SUP-8942 when we have a signed SOW or explicit decline.

mike: Action items captured: disable auto-bill on Annex-934 (done), approve CM (done), file RCA (in progress). I'll update the release notes for the billing pipeline to prevent `ancillary_support` from auto-invoicing.

sarah: :thumbsup: CM processed. I'll attach credit note to INV-20260315 and mark as reconciled in AR. Closing out on finance side after reconciliation.

marta: Thanks everyone — looks like we're all aligned. If Acme signs the annex retroactively, we'll bill and create a revenue adjustment rather than a surprise invoice.

olivia: noted. closing the loop on my side — I'll ping here if/legal needs help.
